intelligence.title: The Input Law — Dictation First, Confirm Always
intelligence.ingest_note: Shawn's Input Law, dictated 2026-11-04 ~20:19-20:30Z and played back to him in chat the same session; filed by Naya Resolve Narzan on 2026-11-05 under the Master Directive's standing order (smart-note it the moment you learn it). This filing SUPERSEDES the older voice-bridge draft (~/workspace/voice-bridge-capture-draft-2026-11-03.md), which must not be filed.
intelligence.essence: Every input in NayaNET is dictation first — voice, then typing, then paste from your own AI. Nothing enters unconfirmed: Naya plays your words back, beautifully formatted, and you confirm or edit before anything is saved or fired.
intelligence.human_view: Shawn designed the input layer of the whole system in one dictation (2026-11-04). Dictation first on ALL inputs, no exceptions — voice first, typing second, paste-from-your-own-AI third. Every input runs the confirm loop: dictate, Naya plays it back beautifully formatted, you confirm or edit, then next — onboarding fields included. Dictated commands are actions, played back as actions, confirmed before firing. Your words become one of three things: plain input filling a page; a private Naya Note in your Smart Box, pinnable and shareable by you alone; or, only by deliberate choice, a Smart Note the whole network learns from, anonymously, with your own copy kept. Voice playback is wanted ASAP, sequenced after dictation; live conversation mode is explicitly not wanted. The seam with the DNA: 'no voice buttons' governs display surfaces; the mic lives inside the input itself.
intelligence.simple_view: Talk first. Naya shows you what she heard. You say yes — then it counts. Nothing slips in unconfirmed, and your words only become a shared Smart Note if you choose that on purpose.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like dictating a letter to a careful secretary: you speak, she reads it back to you lovely and clear, and nothing gets mailed until you nod. Your private notes stay private unless you decide otherwise.
intelligence.naya_view: This law is my input discipline too: I take dictation as design, play it back before building on it, and never let an unconfirmed word become a filed fact. The Welcome walk is the first build site — dictation-first with the confirm loop on the offers/needs/wants fields the matcher reads. Filed under the Master Directive without re-asking, because the standing order already carried the authority.
